scope: Cross-round reuse within batch 3; partial progress, not overall completion
mechanism: Saving a check binds reuse to the current saved evidence digest. The planner requires the same digest and exact identity/version key. Blocked history is never a terminal reuse result.
scenarios: Unchanged saved evidence reuses without another validation action
New product or component references, recorded condition values, packets, method bytes or virtual Host invalidate reuse
Evidence reference order and duplicates alone do not invalidate reuse
Caller-supplied cache stamp cannot replace the current saved context stamp
Blocked history with complete current prerequisites proceeds to minimal controlled validation
Legacy unstamped history stays visible but cannot silently suppress validation
Cumulative supplement counts do not reset when evidence changes

desktop.state: Fixed real-home Desktop is open for user login. Installing these packages requires fully quitting it; no interruption of the pending human login has been performed.
desktop.loginAudit: Current real-home credential document contains an API-key name but no deepseek-account-platform namespace. No credential values were printed or copied. Official account login persists locally and is distinct from the API-key provider route.

limits: Digest equality verifies recorded bytes and references, not the truth or execution of caller observations
No time-expiry policy or live credential freshness check is claimed by this change
Full adaptive execution, independent impact review, Desktop flow and true model token/recall comparison remain incomplete
